guard_audit.scope: Addenbrooke's Hospital Incinerator / EA EPR/WE6264AB versus secondary WP3935SM
guard_audit.evidence: The current Environment Agency installation register lists the Addenbrooke's Hospital Incinerator Boiler House as EPR/WE6264AB, while the public facility page labels the incinerator WP3935SM. The secondary inventory also records zero received in 2022. The permit-number conflict was preserved rather than silently reconciled, and no annual 2024 release was assigned.
